name: Exp_simple_trading_system
summary: This EA implements a simple trend-following trading system based on a custom indicator called 'simple_trading_system' that generates up/down arrow signals. It opens buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels, and supports multiple money management modes including lot-based and margin-based sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标'simple_trading_system'生成的上下箭头信号实现简单的趋势跟踪交易系统。在上涨信号时开多仓，在下跌信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损止盈水平，并提供包括固定手数和保证金比例在内的多种资金管理模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于自定义指标simple_trading_system产生的趋势方向信号进行顺势交易，该指标内部使用EMA移动平均线作为核心计算基础。入场条件为：当指标第1缓冲区（UpValue）在指定信号K线上产生非零非空值时开多仓，当第0缓冲区（DnValue）产生非零非空值时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及反向信号的平仓逻辑——当同时开启开仓和平仓权限且当前无平仓信号时，EA会回溯历史K线查找最近的反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制比例或手数大小，MMMode参数选择具体的计算模式，整体策略逻辑清晰但较为简单，缺乏对市场波动性和交易成本（点差）的考虑。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend-following signals generated by the custom 'simple_trading_system' indicator, which internally uses EMA as its core calculation foundation. Entry conditions are: a buy position is opened when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar, and a sell position is opened when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces such a value. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit levels, plus a reverse-signal closing logic — when both opening and closing permissions are enabled and no close signal exists, the EA backtracks through historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal to determine whether to close positions. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for ratio or lot size and the MMMode parameter for selecting the specific calculation mode. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively simple, lacking consideration for market volatility and trading costs such as spread.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot size as percentage of margin

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（保证金/余额/固定手数等）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot or margin ratio)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，易于理解和维护
提供多种资金管理模式，灵活性较高
支持独立控制开仓和平仓权限，可灵活配置交易方向
有新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic that is easy to understand and maintain
Multiple money management modes provided for flexibility
Independent control of open and close permissions for each direction enables versatile configuration
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries within the same bar
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标逻辑不可见且无法独立验证
缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时可能产生不利成交
止损设为1000点过大，可能导致单笔亏损过高
MAPeriod=2周期极短，容易产生频繁的虚假信号
回溯查找平仓信号的循环可能效率低下，极端情况下遍历所有K线
cons_en: Depends on an external custom indicator whose logic is invisible and cannot be independently verified
No spread filter, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills during high-spread conditions
Stop loss of 1000 points is excessively large, potentially causing high single-trade losses
MAPeriod=2 is extremely short, prone to generating frequent false signals
The backtrack loop for finding close signals may be inefficient, iterating through all bars in extreme cases
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停交易
优化回溯平仓逻辑，设置最大回溯K线数限制，避免无限循环
增加移动平均线周期的合理默认值，并提供信号确认机制减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold
Optimize the backtrack close logic by setting a maximum bar limit to prevent infinite loops
Provide more reasonable default MA period values and add signal confirmation to reduce false signals

risk_points: 止损1000点过大，单笔亏损可能占总资金比例过高
缺乏点差过滤，高波动时段滑点风险显著
自定义指标逻辑不可审计，存在黑箱风险
MAPeriod=2产生频繁信号可能导致过度交易
risk_points_en: 1000-point stop loss is excessively large, single-trade loss may account for too high a percentage of total capital
No spread filter, significant slippage risk during high-volatility periods
Custom indicator logic is unauditable, presenting black-box risk
MAPeriod=2 generates frequent signals that may lead to overtrading

summary_en: This EA implements a simple trend-following trading system based on a custom indicator called 'simple_trading_system' that generates up/down arrow signals. It opens buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels, and supports multiple money management modes including lot-based and margin-based sizing.
